verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's selectable workflows (Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented, Freeform) let you choose how many review points a task gets based on risk, which is a loose, per-task form of tiered oversight. There is no evidence of configurable autonomy levels or permission policies that govern which agent actions run without manual confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit autonomy-level or permission-tier settings, per-action or per-tool approval policies, lead/admin-enforced configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
